title: Evidence-Aware MapReduce for Forkable Compute
summary: Snapshot-backed sandboxes make branching cheap while leaving evidence dependence unchanged. Branches can reuse a model, prompt, repository, tests, observations, or execution ancestor, so counting outputs can amplify one repeated error into high-confidence consensus. We introduce an \emph{evidence-aware reduction contract}: each worker reports an estimate, estimated information, evidence identifiers, fork lineage, and execution metadata.
